title: I spent an hour with Apple's new HomePod smart speaker - here's what it's like (AAPL)
text: I spent an hour with Apple's new HomePod smart speaker — here's what it's like (AAPL) By Avery Hartmans Jan 27, 2018, 9:00 am 11 pts I got a chance to demo Apple's new HomePod smart speaker. The $350 device went on sale Friday and will begin shipping February 9.
